pages.title: Grand Unification
pages.text: $(thing)Grand Unification$()$(br2)At high enough energy, three forces become one.

$(thing)Insight$(): 150$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Supersymmetry, String Theory, Lie Groups.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Superpartner Shard.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): A gauge coupling α is not constant: quantum loops make it change logarithmically with the energy scale μ. With one-loop coefficient b and two-loop coefficient b_2, the inverse coupling changes by −b/(2π) − b_2·α/(8π²) per unit of ln μ. Integrate from the reference scale M up to Q to get 1/α at Q.
